new_categories.label: detector_function_readiness
new_categories.memory: Cargo-area gas/vapor detector-function readiness is a service-state distinct from ventilation, containment and cargo-transfer machinery readiness.

new_categories.label: coverage_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring coverage can be represented as a bounded scope-confidence state without retaining detector locations, counts or placement rules.

new_categories.label: indication_availability_confidence
new_categories.memory: Availability of a usable monitoring indication is distinct from detector physical readiness and from whether the indicated atmosphere is acceptable.

new_categories.label: measurement_validity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Measurement-validity confidence can degrade independently of indication presence without retaining concentrations, calibration values or test methods.

new_categories.label: cross_check_independence_confidence
new_categories.memory: Cross-check or independent assurance confidence is structurally distinct from a single monitoring channel without specifying instrument type or procedure.

new_categories.label: support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Power, sampling-path, control or other support dependency confidence should remain separate from detector-function and indication confidence.

new_categories.label: monitoring_domain_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: The condition of the broader atmosphere-monitoring domain can be represented separately from any one detector or indication channel.

new_categories.label: cargo_area_scope_localization
new_categories.memory: Monitoring assurance can be localized to an affected cargo-area, machinery-space or transfer-interface scope rather than generalized to the whole vessel.

new_categories.label: atmosphere_assurance_not_measurement_equivalence
new_categories.memory: A monitoring indication contributes to atmosphere-assurance confidence but does not by itself prove exact atmospheric condition or operational acceptability.

new_categories.label: gas_vapor_monitoring_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to detector function, coverage, indication, validity, support dependency or affected area scope.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo-operation restriction, atmosphere-assurance concern, terminal incompatibility, rework or schedule effects do not prove a detector, coverage, indication, validity or support root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_monitoring_restoration
new_categories.memory: Physical correction, support recovery, indication return, validity verification, coverage confirmation and operational release may occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: pressure_temperature_instrumentation_vs_atmosphere_monitoring
useful_refinements.memory: P103 pressure/temperature instrumentation refines generic measurement semantics but does not duplicate gas/vapor atmosphere-monitoring scope or validity confidence.

useful_refinements.label: ventilation_vs_detection_assurance
useful_refinements.memory: P089 ventilation/air-exchange readiness is distinct from detecting or validating atmosphere condition; fan or airflow readiness cannot substitute for monitoring confidence.

useful_refinements.label: inert_gas_state_vs_atmosphere_detection
useful_refinements.memory: P091 inert-gas generation/distribution and blanket confidence is not equivalent to independent cargo-area gas/vapor detection or atmosphere-monitoring assurance.

useful_refinements.label: containment_vs_monitoring_assurance
useful_refinements.memory: P104 containment/drainage condition affects downstream assurance but does not establish detector coverage, indication or measurement validity.

duplicates.label: generic_monitoring_support_lifecycle
duplicates.memory: Generic monitoring/support degradation and restoration mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_verification_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope-localization, downstream-effect separation and verified-restoration mechanics are already campaign-wide.

negative_space: exact cargo-area or pump-room detector types, counts, locations, sampling arrangements, concentrations, thresholds, alarm logic, calibration data, test values and current configuration
exact calibration, bump-test, gas-testing, enclosed-space entry, alarm-response, troubleshooting or emergency procedures

private/regional gas-detection and atmosphere-monitoring equipment/service lineages plus non-English predecessor terminology
stop_reason: The bounded structural questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact detector placement, concentration/threshold, alarm logic, calibration/test, entry/emergency, procedure, provider or incident detail that is deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive cargo-area gas/vapor detection and atmosphere-monitoring service-state orientation/source-discovery output; not gas-testing, entry, alarm-response or emergency guidance and not proof of any exact detector type, location, concentration, threshold, alarm logic, calibration state, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
